entities.name: Olutio
entities.description: A gruff man of Innistrad, experienced in forbidden rites, partly responsible for the return of the angel Liesa, killed by the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: Angel whose return Olutio helped bring about.

entities.name: Algli
entities.description: Ally who killed a ghoulcaller with Olutio and learned of the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Sruta
entities.description: Collaborator in the ritual who left in frustration.

entities.name: Buried Lord
entities.description: A being thought to ensure the eternal rest of the dead, awakened as a ravenous demon.

events.summary: After losing his daughter to a ghoulcaller, Olutio seeks Algli and they use forbidden rites to slay the ghoulcaller and rebury the dead.
events.quote: Together, they used Olutio’s forbidden rites to slay the ghoulcaller and rebury the dead.

events.summary: Olutio introduces Algli to the Buried Lord.
events.quote: He introduced Algli to the concept of the Buried Lord

events.summary: Olutio, Algli and Sruta attempt for years to summon the Buried Lord, culminating in a final ritual.
events.quote: enduring many years of failed attempts

events.summary: The ritual appears to fail and Sruta leaves; Olutio follows and is killed by the awakened Buried Lord.
events.quote: only to meet his end at the hands of the Buried Lord

relations.note: Gutted him after awakening as a demon.
relations.quote: only to meet his end at the hands of the Buried Lord
Olutio collaborated with Algli and Sruta
